```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)

source("analysis.R")
```

```{r plot_data}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Time of dream and non-dream per specie"
#| fig-pos: H
#| label: fig-plot_data

ggplot(data = prepped_data,
       aes(x = dreaming, y=non_dreaming)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = 1), alpha = 0.6, color = "blue") +
  labs(
    x = "Dream time",
    y = "Non-dream time"
  ) +
  guides(size = "none")
```

By visually inspecting @fig-plot_data, we do not see collinearity. We verify that there is no perfect collinearity because the correlation between these two values is `r dreaming_non_dreaming_correlation`.
